info.title: ghūl compiler
info.description: compiler for the ghūl programming language

options.name: --analyse
options.description: serve language-service requests on stdin/stdout

options.name: --compile-server
options.description: compile one JSON request per line from stdin, replying on stdout

options.name: --build-server
options.description: build the response file named on each line of stdin, one after another in this process

options.name: --type-check
options.description: parse and type-check only, emitting nothing

options.name: --no-type-check
options.description: parse only

options.name: --check-complete
options.description: parse one source and print complete, incomplete or invalid

options.name: --assembler
options.description: generate code but write no assembly

options.name: --format
options.description: reformat the sources to standard output

options.name: --format-in-place
options.description: reformat the source files themselves

options.name: --format-width
options.description: column the formatter wraps at (default 100)

options.name: --library
options.description: build a library rather than an executable

options.name: --output
options.description: write the assembly here

options.name: --debug
options.description: emit debug information; an llvm build is unoptimised unless --optimise is given

options.name: --optimise
options.description: the llvm target's optimisation level; 2 by default

options.name: --native-input
options.description: link this object file or archive into an llvm build; repeatable

options.name: --native-library
options.description: link the library lib<name>.a into an llvm build; repeatable

options.name: --rtti
options.description: describe the program's types for reflection on wasm

options.name: --version
options.description: version stamped into the assembly

options.name: --assembly
options.description: reference this assembly; repeatable, and naming any replaces the default set

options.name: --reference
options.description: reference this assembly as well as the reference set; repeatable

options.name: --sdk-ref-path
options.description: directory holding the .NET reference assemblies

options.name: --library-prefix
options.description: prefix for resolving referenced assemblies

options.name: --exclude-runtime-symbols
options.description: do not load the ghūl runtime's symbols

options.name: --default-use
options.description: what `use default` imports; comma-separated

options.name: --define
options.description: define a conditional compilation symbol

options.name: --entry
options.description: name of the entry point function

options.name: --global-namespace
options.description: share one namespace across namespace-less files

options.name: --cells
options.description: each namespace-less file is a cell of one session: its namespace is its file name, its entry returns its final expression's value, and it is not the entry point

options.name: --implicit-default-use
options.description: give each namespace-less file an implicit `use default`

options.name: --library-warnings
options.description: report warnings, infos and hints in source library files, which are left out otherwise

options.name: --submission
options.description: compile one step of an interactive session: the namespace-less file's namespace is <name>, and its entry returns its final expression's value

options.name: --cell-link
options.description: compile one cell of a session whose cells are separate objects: the <n> cells before it are declared, not emitted, and its own definitions are exported; implies --session

options.name: --session
options.description: cells as --cells builds them, plus the semantics retained code needs: the narrow guards, the exhaustive-case throw, and open-world dispatch for classes a later cell can extend

options.name: --target
options.description: compile for dotnet, wasm or llvm

options.name: --underscore-access
options.description: underscore visibility: private, protected, legacy

options.name: --wasm-loader
options.description: the loader to write beside a wasm executable, as its name with the extension .mjs, in place of the compiler's own

options.name: --wat
options.description: also write the wasm module's text form to <path>

options.name: --wat-lines
options.description: in that text, a ';; file:line' comment before each statement, and locals named

options.name: --wat-program-only
options.description: in that text, only the functions compiled from the program's own sources

options.name: --llvm-output
options.description: also write the llvm module's text form to <path>

options.name: --llvm-program-only
options.description: in that text, only the functions compiled from the program's own sources

options.name: --llvm-no-link
options.description: with --llvm-output, write that text and link nothing

options.name: --ignore-errors
options.description: carry on emitting after an error

options.name: --suppress
options.description: silence these warnings; comma-separated

options.name: --warn-as-error
options.description: promote these warnings to errors, or all

options.name: --warn-as-info
options.description: demote these warnings to information

options.name: --warn-as-hint
options.description: demote these warnings to editor hints

options.name: --msbuild-diagnostics
options.description: report diagnostics in MSBuild's format

options.name: --incremental-analysis
options.description: reuse the symbol table across edits

options.name: --analysis-idle-timeout
options.description: exit after this long without a request

options.name: --show-analysis-stats
options.description: report timings for each analysis request

options.name: --no-analysis-heap-watchdog
options.description: do not force collection when the heap grows

options.name: --help
options.description: show this message
